_comment: Read by curl-read-allow.py (same directory). A curl target URL auto-approves only if BOTH (1) its host is in allowedHosts AND (2) the allowPrefixes per-host filter passes. allowPrefixes maps a host to path prefixes: ["*"] allows all paths; otherwise the URL path must start with a listed prefix. Hosts in allowedHosts but absent from allowPrefixes are unrestricted on path. allowedHosts match is case-insensitive ('.host' = subdomain wildcard).
